theorems.name: Submission.dgoj_covector_eq_det_mul_of_mem_span
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ b : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (∀ j, b j ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ)) → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, α b = (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (τ i) (b j)).det * α τ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
